name: ANIME MD WhatsApp Bot
description: Anime-themed WhatsApp bot with a built-in Web Pairing dashboard. Developed By: F!xa Dev.

SESSION_ID.description: Contents of session/creds.json (raw JSON or base64). Required on Heroku: the filesystem is wiped on every dyno restart.

THEME.description: Startup theme: makima, nami, nezuko, shinobu, gojo, sukuna or asta.

PUBLIC_MODE.description: Respond in every chat (true) or only for the owner (false).

AUTH_METHOD.description: Keep 'pairing'. The dashboard is web-pairing only.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional key for the !ai command. Never commit a real key.
